translations.web: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.”
translations.bsb: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, who is and was and is to come—the Almighty.
translations.kjv: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.
translations.asv: I am the Alpha and the Omega, saith the Lord God, who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.
